BiblicalUsage: Pâkâh occurs once, in Ezekiel's vision of the temple waters: the man brings him to the east gate, and behold, there run out waters on the right side, trickling from the threshold of the house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the trickle is the beginning of the river: what starts as a small stream from the temple grows until it heals the sea.
